title: SG-5.3.1 · Scene start plays the authored fade transition
summary: BootScene calls the effect context fade with the duration authored in scene content.
description: Context: buildEffects (game/src/engine/buildEffects.ts) skips 'transition' effect specs and says they are played through ctx.playTransition, but nothing calls playTransition. BootScene.create (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) only builds effects, so no fade plays although bedroom.yaml authors a fade transition. Desired behavior: on scene start the authored fade is played with its content duration, and nothing is played when the scene has no transition entry. Why: the fade scene transition is part of the content-driven effects requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with a fade transition entry of 400 ms, when the scene starts, then playTransition is called once with 400.
Given a scene with no transition entry, when the scene starts, then playTransition is not called.

in_scope: Engine helper that reads the transition entry and calls ctx.playTransition
Unit tests with a mocked effect context
out_of_scope: Changing the Phaser camera fade implementation
preserve: BootScene shutdown cleanup and sceneReady event

technical_constraints: Engine code in game/src/engine must not import Phaser; it uses EffectRenderContext
definition_of_done: Both requirements have Act and Verify units merged and green
